use_image.name: Use image
use_image.tooltip: OFF: connected manual_prompt. ON: connected image.

model_id.name: Tagger model
model_id.tooltip: Select a model explicitly: PixAI FP16 (recommended default) or WD FP32. Auto device never changes this model.

device.name: Analysis device
device.tooltip: Auto tries CUDA with CPU auxiliary operations, then the same model on CPU if unavailable. CUDA requires the GPU provider. INT8 may be slower than FP16 on GPU.

allow_download.name: Allow model download
allow_download.tooltip: Download only pinned missing model files. Default OFF.

manual_prompt.name: Text input
manual_prompt.tooltip: Connect String (Multiline). Used unchanged when Use image is OFF.

image.name: Image input
image.tooltip: Connect standard Load Image. Required only when Use image is ON.

mask.name: Optional transparency mask
mask.tooltip: Optional same-size MASK. 1 paints white. Connect Load Image MASK only when transparency is needed.

include_character.name: Include character names
include_character.tooltip: Include detected character names in portraits/body views. Default OFF; names can introduce familiar costumes.

include_copyright.name: Include series names
include_copyright.tooltip: Include detected series names in portraits/body views. Default OFF; appearance may change.

allow_multiple_subjects.name: Allow multiple subjects
allow_multiple_subjects.tooltip: Allow analysis of multiple subjects. Their features may mix. Default OFF.

0.name: prompt
0.tooltip: Unchanged manual text or adopted image tags; connect to Designer prompt.

1.name: profile_json
1.tooltip: Connect with prompt to Designer profile_json. Restricts tags to relevant views.

2.name: raw_tags_json
2.tooltip: All raw scores plus excluded/review candidates. Use Preview Any to inspect.

3.name: diagnostics
3.tooltip: Actual device, cache and timing. Does not affect the image prompt.
